The Bank of England’s most recent Systemic Risk Survey cited cyber as one of the risks that would have the greatest impact on the UK financial system.

haberler.baslik: Panama, Bilgi Teknolojileri Anlaşmasının Genişletilmesine Katılma Talebinde Bulundu
haberler.baslik_kaynak: Panama submits request to join Expansion of the Information Technology Agreement
haberler.ozet: Panama has submitted a request to join the 2015 Expansion of the Information Technology Agreement (ITA II), the Chair of the Committee of Participants on the Expansion of Trade in Information Technology Products, Mr Shih-Chun Weng of Chinese Taipei, informed members at a meeting on 19 November.

haberler.baslik: Fikri Mülkiyet Konularına İlişkin WIPO-DTÖ Yönetici Programı için Başvurular Açıldı
haberler.baslik_kaynak: Applications open for WIPO-WTO Executive Programme on Intellectual Property Issues
haberler.ozet: The Secretariat of the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) and the Secretariat of the World Trade Organization (WTO) are now accepting applications for the WIPO-WTO Executive Programme on Intellectual Property Issues for Senior Government Officials.

haberler.baslik: DTÖ'nün yıllık öğrenci etkinliğinde ticaretin temel unsurlarına odaklanma
haberler.baslik_kaynak: Spotlight on trade fundamentals at annual WTO student event
haberler.ozet: Over 200 students joined policymakers, executives and thought leaders on 18 November at the WTO to discuss trade fundamentals at the WTO's annual student-only event on trade, titled WTO 101: Trade Rules!.
